hero.title: Software that's intelligent enough to run businesses.
body: Digit's platform is built for software that does more than answer questions or wait for instructions.
It can coordinate work, use specialized agents, keep track of what the business knows, act through connected systems, and surface the decisions that still need a person.

overview.headline: The parts work together.
body: Running a business requires more than a capable model or a collection of isolated agents.
Digit combines software for coordination, execution, knowledge, oversight, and specialized work into one operating platform.

Neo coordinates the operation. Mission Control gives people a view across the business. Cerebro keeps what the organization knows. Specialized agents perform focused work. Morpheus provides the execution environment beneath them.
Each part has a different job, but they work from the same operation.

neo.headline: Neo coordinates the business.
body: Instead of treating every request as an isolated task, Neo works across the broader operation. Priorities, active work, business context, decisions, problems, and opportunities can stay connected as the company moves forward.
Neo can coordinate work across different parts of the business, bring the right problems to a person, and keep routine operations moving within the limits the business has set.
The goal is simple: people should be able to lead the company without personally coordinating every piece of work inside it.

items.title: Priorities
items.body: Keep important work connected to what the business is trying to accomplish.

items.title: Coordination
items.body: Bring different kinds of work together when an objective crosses systems or specialties.

items.title: Decisions
items.body: Separate work that can continue autonomously from decisions that need a person.

items.title: Attention
items.body: Surface the issues that actually matter instead of turning every event into an alert.

missionControl.headline: See the business as it operates.
missionControl.lead: Mission Control is the human interface to Digit's autonomous operations.
body: It brings the business into one place so people can understand what is happening without digging through agents, logs, tools, and disconnected systems.

The view can cover operations, businesses, financials, objectives, decisions, learning, company knowledge, and system health. When something needs a person, Mission Control should make the next step clear.

items.title: Company
items.body: Understand the state of the organization and its businesses.

items.title: Operations
items.body: See what is active, what has finished, and what is blocked.

items.title: Decisions
items.body: Review the actions that need human judgment before they continue.

items.title: Financials
items.body: Inspect revenue, expenses, profit, budgets, and financial activity where available.

items.title: Learning
items.body: See what the business has learned from recent work and experiments.

items.title: System
items.body: Understand whether the software and connected services are operating normally.

cerebro.headline: What the business knows, in one connected system.
cerebro.intro: Businesses produce useful knowledge every day. Research, operating experience, decisions, evidence, procedures, results, and lessons often end up scattered across files and software.
cerebro.lead: Cerebro gives Digit a place to keep that knowledge connected.
body: A record can retain what was learned, where it came from, how it relates to other knowledge, and where it may be useful again. That gives future work access to more than the current conversation or task.
Cerebro is built as institutional memory for an operating company.

closing.headline: The platform is only useful if it can operate in the real world.
body: The deeper engineering behind Digit covers execution, knowledge, integrations, governance, reliability, and the systems required to carry intelligent work across a business.
